data.body: Deploy and live-check status (read-only SSM). mcp-deployed-sha reached d533791e73f6 at 2026-11-04 08:50 PST (container rebar-mcp-d533791e73f6-8092, healthy). A later deploy is now live: rebar-mcp-1c8a67702f81-8093, which contains the fix. /var/gerrit/site/.rebar does not exist, as expected. The [non-codebase] AC is still PENDING: in the hour after deploy, the MCP clone's reflog shows only 'reset: moving to origin/tickets' entries and no commits, so no close went through MCP and the trigger never ran; the 3 STATUS events on the tickets branch in that window came from other writers. The first MCP close should fire a sweep (no stamp at the new path yet) and write .git/rebar-compact-sweep.stamp. To finish: confirm the stamp exists in /var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets/.git and nothing is in /var/gerrit/site/.rebar; tick all 6 boxes with a provenance line on the [non-codebase] item; re-run review-plan; close with --class preexisting. Left in_progress until then.
